name: pi-craft
description: Pi Craft - Automated development workflows with subagents, token tracking, and provider optimization

enableSubagent.description: Enable subagent delegation (inline in current session)

enableParallelSubagent.description: Enable parallel/chain subagent execution via isolated processes. When disabled, only inline single-agent delegation is available.

enableCwdGuard.description: Restrict write/edit/bash write operations to the project working directory. Read operations are unrestricted.
